title: An 'attack [name] with [weapon]' option is present on essentially every character, including friendly NPCs on the very first turn you meet them, with no narrative cue that hostility is warranted — e.g. 'attack Brother Osk with short sword' appears the instant you meet a novice sweeping a chapel floor.
where: Gray Chapel, first meeting Brother Osk (recurs with Vell, Tamsin, Regent Ysolde, etc.)
